evals.prompt: Use go-for-it for the settled design in this conversation.
evals.expected_output: The agent resumes the fixed scope-to-PR checkpoint chain and stops after returning the matching pull-request URL; it does not create a reviewer task or run get-pr-ready because --ready is absent.

evals.prompt: Use go-for-it --ready --max-fix-rounds 4 for this settled design.
evals.expected_output: Before mutation the agent validates get-pr-ready availability and required host capabilities, strips readiness controls from the delivery input, completes all normal go-for-it phases through PR creation, then delegates the exact created PR URL and max-round option to get-pr-ready; reviewer setup occurs only after the PR exists.

evals.prompt: Use go-for-it --review-session task_abc for this work.
evals.expected_output: The agent rejects the readiness-only option before any mutating phase because --ready is absent.

evals.prompt: Use go-for-it --ready --review-session task_abc for this settled change. The PR is created successfully, but the supplied task cannot be contacted.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the completed scope, worktree, commits, push, and PR; lets get-pr-ready retry reviewer setup once; then reports blocked without deleting or rolling back the PR.
